result:
Everything's clean — no stray test artifacts, `.env.local`, or `node_modules` pollution left behind.

## Summary

Implemented `TemplateClauseLibraryPage` (UC3) and its five owned components per the task contract:

- **Page**: `src/pages/TemplateClauseLibraryPage.jsx` — tabs, role-gated access (Tenant Admin/Legal Reviewer only), editor orchestration, deactivate/reactivate confirmation, version history modal
- **Components**: `TemplatesTab`, `ClauseLibraryTab`, `TemplateEditor`, `ClauseEditor`, `VersionHistoryModal` (plus small `LibraryStatusBadge`/`RiskLevelBadge` helpers) under `src/features/templates/`
- **Services**: extended `templatesService.js` additively, added new `clausesService.js`, both calling exactly the 12 contracted endpoints
- **Hooks**: 12 new hooks (list + create/update/deactivate/reactivate/versions for both templates and clauses)
- **Store**: `templateLibrarySlice.js` zustand slice
- **Route**: `/settings/template-clause-library` added to `App.jsx`
- **Tests**: `src/__tests__/TemplateClauseLibraryPage.test.jsx` (6 new tests)

All checks pass: lint clean, 25/25 tests pass, build succeeds. I visually verified against a locally mocked backend (no mock code committed) and screenshots closely matched all five target design states (list grid, Clause Library grid with risk colors, New Template editor, New Clause editor, Version History modal).

Notably, the spec contained **two internal story contradictions** (Contract Owner access in BR-004 vs BR-009/010, and Legal Reviewer's Deactivate rights in BR-004/007/012 vs BR-008 — the latter even flagged as unresolved in the source). I resolved both using the endpoint role contracts (the more authoritative, machine-checked source) and documented the reasoning in `blockers`, along with several inferred-but-undocumented details (Template Category list, merge field list, missing AF-005 upload endpoint). Full details are in `.ui-gen/outputs/T-TEMPLATE-CLAUSE-LIBRARY-PAGE-UI.json`.
